notes.title: Update with new graphics and audio effects
notes.content: Update brings an additional option for players that reached at least 10.000 points in singleplayer to activate new graphical and audio effects. You might argue that should be included for anybody but hey...why not make playing on a halfway decent level be worthwhile.
